findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a the old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The new code uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) as the light-theme branch of dark-light-choose. That lightens the link in the default light theme instead of preserving it; the dark branch alone should have been added as scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%) with primary kept at 30%.

findings.title: Custom-message-length lightness flipped 70% to 30%
findings.body: Old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). New light branch is scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). Desktop modal.scss for the same selector correctly keeps 70% / 30%. The mobile change darkens the text in the light theme and diverges from desktop.

findings.title: Topic-map h3 lightness changed 20% to 50%
findings.body: Old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). New code is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). Desktop topic-post.scss keeps the equivalent h3 at 20% / 80%. The mobile edit changes the light-theme appearance instead of only adding a dark-theme branch.

findings.title: Group member name lightness changed 30% to 50%
findings.body: Old .group-member-info .name was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). New light branch is 50%, i.e. dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). Adjacent .username a / .name rules use 30% / 70%. This changes the light-theme color rather than preserving it; it should be 30% / 70%.

findings.title: Group member name lightness changed 30% to 50% on mobile
findings.body: Old .group-member-info .name was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). New code uses dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). That alters the established light-theme value; consistent with the rest of the PR it should be 30% for $primary and 70% for $secondary.
